article_content: A South African army officer, reportedly intoxicated, allegedly surrounded a police station where his men were being held after being found at an illegal drinking den, according to reports. The senior officer reportedly became enraged upon learning his men had been arrested in Oudtshoorn, near the south coast. A complaint states that the officer went to the local Bongolethu Police Station and surrounded it with approximately 120 soldiers and two armoured personnel carriers, demanding the release of the arrested personnel. The arrested individuals, allegedly including soldiers and at least one officer, were reportedly found by police at an illegal drinking den celebrating a change of command at their training base. According to a complaint from the South African National Defence Union (Sandu), the officer mobilized troops upon hearing of the arrests. Sandu described the incident as, 'A certain Army general who, whilst allegedly intoxicated, unlawfully mobilised armed soldiers and armoured infantry fighting vehicles in order to free a senior ranking officer and several other soldiers.' Local media reported that troops surrounded Oudtshoorn’s Bongolethu Police Station. Police secured the station and armed themselves. Following negotiations, police agreed to release the soldiers. Sandu expressed 'utter dismay' at the incident, labeling it a 'military-backed armed insurrection against the police'. Oudtshoorn is located near South Africa’s south coast. Local reports detailed the troops surrounding the Bongolethu Police Station. After negotiation, police agreed to release the soldiers. Sandu also claimed that military authorities had warned its members in Oudtshoorn against discussing the incident, threatening disciplinary action. Sandu’s national secretary, Pikkie Greeff, stated, 'Soldiers in Oudtshoorn were warned by military authorities to remain silent about this incident or face disciplinary measures.' 'We demand that the South African National Defence Force immediately suspends the [officer] involved and investigates charges of intimidation and sedition against him,' Greeff added. 'His conduct clearly demonstrates an abuse of rank and a belief in being above the law. Furthermore, it indicates he is irresponsible and dangerous to be in command of military personnel and equipment.' A South African police spokesman confirmed that 31 individuals were arrested at an unlicensed bar in Oudtshoorn on Friday but could not confirm if soldiers were among them. The police spokesman added that they are 'investigating a case of intimidation against three individuals whose employment status remains unverified'.

article_content: By Alex Greig. Visitors to Yahoo.com over the past week may have been affected by malware coming from the site's ads. According to online security firm Fox-IT, based in the Netherlands, users who clicked on ads from the site were redirected to sites that exploited vulnerabilities in Java and installed a host of different malware. 'Clients visiting yahoo.com received advertisements served by ads.yahoo.com,' the internet security firm Fox-IT posted on its blog. 'Some of the advertisements are malicious.' Yahoo users may have been affected by malware, with the malware affecting tens of thousands of computers per hour. Fox-IT estimates that tens of thousands of users were affected per hour. According to Fox-IT, 'Given a typical infection rate of 9%, this would result in around 27,000 infections every hour.' 'Based on the same sample, the countries most affected by the exploit kit are Romania, Great Britain, and France.' It is currently unclear why these countries are most affected, but it is likely due to the configuration of the malicious advertisements on Yahoo. Yahoo issued a statement about the security breach on Saturday night: 'At Yahoo, we take the safety and privacy of our users seriously,' Fox-IT created a graph showing the countries most affected by the malware attack and stated that they were unable to identify those responsible, but believe the attack was 'clearly financially motivated.' Fox-IT provides details on how to prevent malware access by blocking the IP addresses of the malicious ads and the exploit kit. Computers connected to a network can spread the malware to many more computers. The malware may have started spreading from December 30. Yahoo stated they are monitoring the problem: 'We recently identified an ad designed to spread malware to some of our users. We immediately removed it and will continue to monitor and block any ads being used for this activity.'

Saskaņā ar tiešsaistes drošības uzņēmumu "Fox-IT" Nīderlandē, lietotāji, kuri noklikšķināja uz reklāmām, tika pārvirzīti uz vietnēm, kas izmantoja "Java" drošības ievainojamības un instalēja dažādas ļaunprogrammatūras. "Klienti, kas apmeklē yahoo.com, saņēma reklāmas no ads.yahoo.com," interneta drošības uzņēmums "Fox-IT" rakstīja savā blogā. "Daļa reklāmu ir ļaunprātīgas." Yahoo lietotāji varēja tikt ietekmēti no ļaunprogrammatūras, kas stundā inficēja desmitiem tūkstošu datoru. "Fox-IT" lēš, ka stundā tika ietekmēti desmitiem tūkstošu lietotāju. Saskaņā ar "Fox-IT" datiem: "Ņemot vērā tipisko infekcijas līmeni 9%, tas varētu radīt aptuveni 27 000 infekcijas katru stundu." "Balstoties uz to pašu paraugu, visvairāk skartās valstis ir Rumānija, Lielbritānija un Francija." Pašlaik nav skaidrs, kāpēc šīs valstis ir visvairāk skartas, bet visticamāk, tas ir saistīts ar ļaunprātīgo reklāmu konfigurāciju Yahoo vietnē. Yahoo sestdienas vakarā izdeva paziņojumu par drošības pārkāpumu: "Mēs Yahoo nopietni uztveram mūsu lietotāju drošību un privātumu." "Fox-IT" izveidoja grafiku, kas parāda visvairāk skartās valstis no ļaunprogrammatūras uzbrukuma, un norādīja, ka nespēja identificēt atbildīgos, bet uzskata, ka uzbrukums bija "skaidri finansiāli motivēts." "Fox-IT" sniedz informāciju par to, kā novērst ļaunprogrammatūras piekļuvi, bloķējot ļaunprātīgo reklāmu un "exploit kit" IP adreses. Datori, kas ir savienoti tīklā, var izplatīt ļaunprogrammatūru vēl daudziem datoriem. Iespējams, ļaunprogrammatūra sāka izplatīties 30. decembrī. Yahoo paziņoja, ka uzrauga situāciju: "Mēs nesen identificējām reklāmu, kas bija paredzēta ļaunprogrammatūras izplatīšanai dažiem mūsu lietotājiem. Mēs to nekavējoties noņēmām un turpināsim uzraudzīt un bloķēt jebkādas reklāmas, kas tiek izmantotas šim nolūkam."

article_content: A former high-ranking detective, Clive Driscoll, who successfully prosecuted two of Stephen Lawrence’s killers, asserts that senior figures at Scotland Yard are no longer prioritizing this case. Driscoll, who recently retired from the Metropolitan Police, also suggests that his successful investigation into Gary Dobson and David Norris was actively hindered by internal ‘disruptive tactics’. He further claims that high-ranking Met officers discussed withholding specific documents from the Ellison Review, an independent inquiry examining claims of police corruption in the Lawrence case. Clive Driscoll, instrumental in bringing two of Stephen Lawrence’s murderers to justice, believes Scotland Yard leaders have lost focus on this matter. He cautioned, ‘A single poor decision regarding disclosure can negate the valuable work of police officers nationwide. Personally, I advocate for complete openness and honesty, flaws included.’ Advocates for Driscoll, who achieved the rank of detective chief inspector and had the confidence of Stephen’s parents, Neville and Doreen, contend his departure from the Met was unjustly enforced as part of budget cuts. They also argue his leaving reflects the force’s decreasing dedication to Stephen’s case, which has already cost millions in investigations, inquiries, and family compensation. Tragedy: Stephen Lawrence was 18 when he died from stab wounds near an Eltham bus stop in south-east London in April 1993, a victim of a racist attack by a group of white youths. Duwayne Brooks, Stephen’s close friend and witness, expresses diminished trust in the Met due to Driscoll’s forced retirement in May. However, Yard sources maintain that the force is still dedicated to prosecuting all those responsible for Stephen’s murder, noting Driscoll’s eligibility for full retirement after over 30 years of service. Stephen Lawrence was 18 when he was fatally stabbed near a bus stop in Eltham, south-east London, in April 1993, in a racially motivated assault by white youths. After numerous mismanaged and unsuccessful inquiries, Driscoll ultimately led a successful investigation. Dobson and Norris, initially identified as prime suspects in 1997 by the Daily Mail, were convicted of murder in January 2012, thanks to a forensic breakthrough. However, Driscoll stated that some officers within the Met opposed a ‘successful prosecution’. He told BBC2’s Newsnight, ‘I definitely felt there were individuals at senior levels in the Met who lacked enthusiasm for the investigation.’ His concern over ‘disruption tactics’ led him to email senior officers with his worries. In his Newsnight interview, he did not detail these concerns. He observed that the relationship between the Lawrence family and the Met is currently as strained as it was immediately after Stephen’s murder, urging the Met to be fully transparent to regain public trust. He stated, ‘I believe we are now positioned to learn and rectify past errors.’ Responding to the retired detective’s assertions, Duwayne Brooks told Radio 4’s Today programme yesterday that he hasn’t yet spoken to anyone from the new Met team investigating Stephen’s murder. ‘I want to see more convictions, everyone involved brought to justice,’ he said. He questioned his ability to trust the police following Driscoll’s departure. ‘The way Clive has been treated is not how I would expect the Metropolitan Police to treat someone who secured a conviction… a conviction considered impossible,’ he added. Jocelyn Cockburn, Neville Lawrence’s solicitor, commented on Today, ‘Like Duwayne Brooks, it’s unfortunate that the successful murder inquiry team, trusted by Mr. Lawrence, has been replaced post-conviction. There’s a sense that the murder investigation is being shut down. Mr. Lawrence needs reassurance that it’s being actively pursued.’ She mentioned Mr. Lawrence is seeking further inquiry into alleged ‘lack of transparency and cooperation’ within the Met regarding the 1998 Macpherson Inquiry into Stephen’s murder, which examined potential corruption in the initial investigation. ‘If Mr. Driscoll’s claims of attempts to derail the recent murder investigation are true, that’s a significant new development,’ she concluded. The Met stated that no Stephen Lawrence material was intentionally withheld from the Ellison Review and that their policy is openness and transparency. They reiterated their commitment to the ongoing Lawrence investigation.

Stīvenam Lorensam bija 18 gadi, kad viņš tika nāvējoši sadurts pie autobusa pieturas Elthamā, Londonas dienvidaustrumos, 1993. gada aprīlī, rasistiski motivētā uzbrukumā, ko veica baltādainie jaunieši. Pēc daudzām neveiksmīgām un neizdevušām izmeklēšanām Driskols galu galā vadīja veiksmīgu izmeklēšanu. Dobsons un Noriss, kas sākotnēji 1997. gadā laikrakstā Daily Mail tika identificēti kā galvenie aizdomās turamie, tika notiesāti par slepkavību 2012. gada janvārī, pateicoties tiesu medicīnas sasniegumam. Tomēr Driskols apgalvoja, ka daži virsnieki Metropolitēna policijā iebilda pret ‘veiksmīgu kriminālvajāšanu’. Viņš BBC2 raidījumam Newsnight sacīja: ‘Es noteikti jutu, ka Metropolitēna policijā ir personas augstākā līmenī, kurām trūka entuziasma par izmeklēšanu.’ Bažas par ‘destruktīvu taktiku’ viņu pamudināja nosūtīt e-pastu augstākajiem virsniekiem ar savām bažām. Intervijā Newsnight viņš sīkāk nepaskaidroja šīs bažas. Viņš novēroja, ka attiecības starp Lorensa ģimeni un Metropolitēna policiju pašlaik ir tikpat saspīlētas kā tūlīt pēc Stīvena slepkavības, mudinot Metropolitēna policiju būt pilnībā pārredzamai, lai atgūtu sabiedrības uzticību. Viņš paziņoja: ‘Es uzskatu, ka mēs tagad esam pozīcijā, lai mācītos un labotu pagātnes kļūdas.’ Atbildot uz pensionētā detektīva apgalvojumiem, Duvēns Brukss vakar Radio 4 raidījumam Today sacīja, ka vēl nav runājis ar nevienu no jaunās Metropolitēna policijas komandas, kas izmeklē Stīvena slepkavību. ‘Es vēlos redzēt vairāk notiesājošu spriedumu, lai visus iesaistītos sauktu pie atbildības,’ viņš sacīja. Viņš apšaubīja savu spēju uzticēties policijai pēc Driskola aiziešanas. ‘Veids, kādā izturas pret Klaivu, nav tas, kā es gaidītu, ka Metropolitēna policija izturēsies pret kādu, kurš ir panācis notiesājošu spriedumu… notiesājošu spriedumu, kas tika uzskatīts par neiespējamu,’ viņš piebilda. Džoselīna Kokbērna, Nevila Lorensa advokāte, raidījumā Today komentēja: ‘Līdzīgi kā Duvēns Brukss, ir nožēlojami, ka veiksmīgā slepkavības izmeklēšanas komanda, kurai uzticējās Lorensa kungs, pēc notiesāšanas ir nomainīta. Ir sajūta, ka slepkavības izmeklēšana tiek slēgta. Lorensa kungam ir nepieciešams pārliecināties, ka tā tiek aktīvi turpināta.’ Viņa minēja, ka Lorensa kungs meklē turpmāku izmeklēšanu par apgalvojumiem par ‘pārredzamības un sadarbības trūkumu’ Metropolitēna policijā attiecībā uz 1998. gada Makfersona izmeklēšanu par Stīvena slepkavību, kurā tika pārbaudīta iespējamā korupcija sākotnējā izmeklēšanā. ‘Ja Driskola kunga apgalvojumi par mēģinājumiem novērst neseno slepkavības izmeklēšanu ir patiesi, tad tas ir nozīmīgs jauns fakts,’ viņa secināja. Metropolitēna policija paziņoja, ka nekādi Stīvena Lorensa materiāli netika tīši slēpti no Elisona pārskata un ka viņu politika ir atklātība un pārredzamība. Viņi atkārtoti apstiprināja savu apņemšanos turpināt Lorensa izmeklēšanu.

article_content: An elderly homeless man has been reunited with his long lost daughter over Skype after 24 years apart. The touching moment brought Jimmy Francis, 74, and Natalie Caler to tears as he told her, 'I love you, it's been a long time.' The emotional reunion was made possible by kind-hearted Las Vegas realtor Jim Snyder and his wife Maria, who are now raising money to get Francis and California-based Caler together in person. Mr. Snyder discovered Francis hungry and shivering outside a Las Vegas sandwich shop earlier that week. He bought the man something to eat and left. But Snyder couldn't get the image of Francis hunched over in the cold out of his head, so he drove back, picked him up, and took him home. 'When I took him that sandwich and I handed it to him and how cold he was, it broke my heart,' he told KTNV.com. After giving Francis some coffee and a hot shower and washing his clothes, the pair chatted, and Mr. Snyder learned that the man had been living on the streets for 10 months after his wife left him and he lost everything. He also learned Francis had battled cancer and nearly died and was trying to reconnect with his six children. Surviving the illness made finding his family more important than ever, Francis told him. Overcome by the story, the Snyders decided to do everything they could to help. Francis told Ms. Snyder the names of his children, and she searched for them on Facebook. It didn't take long before she discovered Caler, who fitted Francis' description of the daughter he'd lost touch with years ago when her mother cut off contact. Ms. Snyder sent her a message and soon received one back. 'She was shocked, crying, amazed. The first thing she wanted to know (was) is this my dad? Is he doing okay?' Mr. Snyder told KTNV.com. The woman told the Snyders she had been searching for her father for many years but didn't have any luck. 'She was so happy to know he was ok but saddened that he was homeless,' Ms. Snyder said. 'We were able to re-unite them over the phone for several hours over multiple emotional conversations.' During those conversations, Francis learned that he had five grandchildren and five great-grandchildren in California, where Caler works as a truck driver. The Snyders then reconnected the father and daughter on Skype, allowing them to see each other's faces for the first time in a quarter-century. Both were moved to tears to see each other again after such a long time apart. But after the crying, there were a lot of laughs. 'There is no way I could ever repay them for what they've done. Not even knowing me,' Francis told KTNV.com of the loving family that helped him rebuild his own. Ms. Snyder said she was proud of her husband for taking the needy man in and thrilled they could help him reconnect with his daughter. 'We could not believe what was unfolding in front of us,' she said. 'I believe my husband Jim was meant to be there to help this man and quite literally save his life. We are so overjoyed to be a part of this and be able to re-unite them.' The Snyders are now trying to raise enough money to get Francis to California to be with Caler, his grandchildren, and great-grandchildren, because neither can afford the plane fare. They are also hoping to find Francis' other children in the process. If you would like to help, you can donate to their campaign on website FundRazr here. 'With all the bad news in this world, it is nice to have a story that makes you feel good,' Ms. Snyder said. 'Jimmy is a great man.'
translated_content: Gados vecāks bezpajumtnieks pēc 24 gadu šķirtības, izmantojot Skype, atkal satikās ar savu sen pazudušo meitu. Aizkustinošais brīdis saviļņoja 74 gadus veco Džimiju Fransisu un Natāliju Kaleru līdz asarām, kad viņš viņai teica: "Es tevi mīlu, tas ir bijis ļoti ilgs laiks." Šo emocionālo atkalredzēšanos padarīja iespējamu labsirdīgs nekustamo īpašumu aģents no Lasvegasas, Džims Snaiders, un viņa sieva Marija, kuri tagad vāc ziedojumus, lai Fransisu un Kalifornijā dzīvojošo Kaleru satuvinātu klātienē. Snaiders atrada Fransisu izsalkušu un drebošu ārpus sviestmaižu veikala Lasvegasā iepriekšējā nedēļā. Viņš nopirka vīrietim kaut ko ēdamu un devās prom. Tomēr Snaiders nespēja aizmirst Fransisa tēlu, kas bija saliecies aukstumā, tāpēc viņš atgriezās, paņēma viņu un aizveda mājās. "Kad es viņam pasniedzu sviestmaizi un redzēju, cik ļoti viņš sala, man sāpēja sirds," viņš stāstīja KTNV.com. Pēc tam, kad Snaiders iedeva Fransisam karstu kafiju, ļāva nomazgāties karstā dušā un izmazgāja drēbes, abi aprunājās, un Snaiders uzzināja, ka vīrietis jau 10 mēnešus dzīvo uz ielas pēc tam, kad sieva viņu pameta un viņš zaudēja visu. Viņš arī uzzināja, ka Fransiss ir pārcietis vēzi un gandrīz nomira, un tagad mēģina atjaunot saikni ar saviem sešiem bērniem. Izdzīvošana pēc smagās slimības padarīja ģimenes atrašanu vēl svarīgāku, kā jebkad agrāk, Fransiss viņam teica. Šī stāsta iedvesmoti, Snaideri nolēma darīt visu iespējamo, lai palīdzētu. Fransiss nosauca Snaideres kundzei savu bērnu vārdus, un viņa meklēja tos Facebook. Nepagāja ilgs laiks, līdz viņa atrada Kaleru, kas atbilda Fransisa aprakstam par meitu, ar kuru viņš bija zaudējis saikni pirms daudziem gadiem, kad viņas māte bija pārtraukusi kontaktus. Snaideres kundze nosūtīja viņai ziņu un drīz saņēma atbildi. "Viņa bija šokēta, raudāja un bija apbrīnojami pārsteigta. Pirmais, ko viņa vēlējās zināt, bija: vai tas tiešām ir mans tēvs? Vai ar viņu viss ir labi?" Snaiders stāstīja KTNV.com. Sieviete Snaideriem pastāstīja, ka viņa jau daudzus gadus meklē savu tēvu, bet bez panākumiem. "Viņa bija tik laimīga, uzzinot, ka ar viņu viss ir kārtībā, bet arī skumīga par to, ka viņš ir bezpajumtnieks," sacīja Snaideres kundze. "Mums izdevās viņus atkal savedāt kopā pa tālruni vairāku stundu garumā, veicot daudzas emocionālas sarunas." Šo sarunu laikā Fransiss uzzināja, ka viņam Kalifornijā ir pieci mazbērni un pieci mazmazbērni, kur Kalere strādā par kravas automašīnas vadītāju. Pēc tam Snaideri atkal savienoja tēvu un meitu, izmantojot Skype, ļaujot viņiem pirmo reizi 25 gadu laikā redzēt vienam otra sejas. Abi bija ļoti aizkustināti un raudāja, atkal redzot viens otru pēc tik ilga laika šķirtības. Tomēr pēc asarām sekoja arī daudz smieklu. "Es nekad nespēšu viņiem atlīdzināt par to, ko viņi ir izdarījuši. Pat nepazīstot mani," Fransiss teica KTNV.com par šo mīļo ģimeni, kas palīdzēja viņam atkal atrast savējo. Snaideres kundze teica, ka lepojas ar savu vīru par to, ka viņš paņēma pie sevis šo trūcīgo vīrieti, un ir sajūsmā par to, ka viņi varēja palīdzēt viņam atjaunot saikni ar savu meitu. "Mēs nespējām noticēt tam, kas notika mūsu acu priekšā," viņa sacīja. "Es ticu, ka manam vīram Džimam bija jābūt tur, lai palīdzētu šim vīrietim un burtiski izglābtu viņa dzīvību. Mēs esam ārkārtīgi priecīgi būt daļa no šī notikuma un varēt viņus atkal savedāt kopā." Snaideri tagad cenšas savākt pietiekami daudz ziedojumu, lai nogādātu Fransisu Kalifornijā pie Kaleres, viņa mazbērniem un mazmazbērniem, jo neviens no viņiem nevar atļauties lidmašīnas biļetes. Viņi arī cer šajā procesā atrast Fransisa pārējos bērnus. Ja vēlaties palīdzēt, jūs varat ziedot viņu kampaņai mājaslapā FundRazr, sekojot šai saitei. "Ņemot vērā visas sliktās ziņas pasaulē, ir patīkami dzirdēt stāstu, kas liek justies labi," sacīja Snaideres kundze. "Džimijs ir lielisks cilvēks."

article_content: Forget boring parking lots! Innovative and beautiful parking structures are popping up around the globe, transforming how we think about car storage.  No longer just a mundane task, parking is getting a stylish makeover. Take, for instance, the Autostadt in Germany, often called the world's most famous car park. Situated near the Volkswagen factory in Wolfsburg, this isn't just parking; it's a car-themed complex with offices, a museum, and production areas. Its showstopper is definitely the twin 60-meter towers made of glass and steel. These towers are like a final destination for new cars fresh from the factory. For a different vibe, check out 1111 Lincoln Road in Miami Beach. This open-air garage, designed by Swiss architects Herzog & de Meuron, has an Art Deco feel and is said to look like a 'house of cards'.  It’s not just for parking either; you'll find a fancy fashion store on the fifth floor, an event space on the seventh, and even a penthouse apartment with a pool and gardens. In the UK, architectural car park wonders include Q Park Charles Street in Sheffield, nicknamed 'Cheesegrater' for its cube-like shape, and Millennium Point car park in Birmingham. Designed by Mark Sloane from Acivico Ltd, the Birmingham car park is known for its blue glow at night. Down in Melbourne, Australia, the Eureka Tower car park is another example of trend-setting design. As part of the city’s tallest building, it offers nine parking levels with a cool painted interior that creates a 3D effect. Interestingly, some car parks are repurposing old spaces. The Michigan Theatre in Detroit, with its gothic charm, was once a nightclub before becoming a 160-space, three-level car park.  Santa Monica Civic Centre in California is an eco-conscious option, accommodating regular cars, electric vehicles, and even bikes.  And in Vancouver, the Cordova Parkade is in a former department store, aiming to bring life back to the city’s east side. These examples show that car parks are evolving into more than just places to leave your car – they are becoming architectural statements and even multi-purpose spaces.
translated_content: Aizmirstiet garlaicīgas autostāvvietas! Inovatīvas un skaistas autostāvvietu struktūras parādās visā pasaulē, pārveidojot to, kā mēs domājam par automašīnu novietošanu. Automašīnas novietošana vairs nav tikai ikdienišķs uzdevums, bet gan iegūst stilīgu pārvērtību. Piemēram, apskatiet Autostadt Vācijā, ko bieži sauc par pasaulē slavenāko autostāvvietu. Volfsburgā pie Volkswagen rūpnīcas atrodošais komplekss nav tikai autostāvvieta; tas ir ar automašīnām saistīts komplekss ar birojiem, muzeju un ražošanas zonām. Tā galvenais akcents noteikti ir divi 60 metru torņi, kas izgatavoti no stikla un tērauda. Šie torņi ir kā galapunkts jaunām automašīnām, kas nāk tieši no rūpnīcas. Lai iegūtu citādu noskaņu, apskatiet 1111 Lincoln Road Maiami Bīčā. Šai atklātā tipa garāžai, ko projektējuši Šveices arhitekti Herzog & de Meuron, ir Art Deco noskaņa un tiek teikts, ka tā atgādina "kāršu namiņu". Tā nav paredzēta tikai automašīnu novietošanai; piektajā stāvā atradīsiet greznu modes veikalu, septītajā - pasākumu telpu un pat penthouse dzīvokli ar baseinu un dārziem. Lielbritānijā arhitektūras autostāvvietu brīnumi ietver Q Park Charles Street Šefīldā, ko kubveida formas dēļ iesaukuši par "Siera rīvi", un Millennium Point autostāvvietu Birmingemā. Birmingemas autostāvvieta, ko projektējis Marks Sloans no Acivico Ltd, ir pazīstama ar savu zilo mirdzumu naktī. Austrālijā, Melburnā, Eureka Tower autostāvvieta ir vēl viens tendences noteicoša dizaina piemērs. Kā daļa no pilsētas augstākās ēkas, tā piedāvā deviņus autostāvvietu līmeņus ar vēsu krāsotu interjeru, kas rada 3D efektu. Interesanti, ka dažas autostāvvietas pārveido vecas telpas. Mičiganas teātris Detroitā ar savu gotisko šarmu reiz bija naktsklubs, pirms kļuva par 160 vietu, trīs līmeņu autostāvvietu. Santa Monica Civic Centre Kalifornijā ir videi draudzīgs variants, kas piemērots parastām automašīnām, elektromobiļiem un pat velosipēdiem. Savukārt Vankūverā Cordova Parkade atrodas bijušajā universālveikalā, un tās mērķis ir atdzīvināt pilsētas austrumu pusi. Šie piemēri rāda, ka autostāvvietas attīstās par kaut ko vairāk nekā tikai vietas, kur atstāt automašīnu – tās kļūst par arhitektūras paziņojumiem un pat daudzfunkcionālām telpām.
